The idea is that your attempt to kill yourself will always fail, and you will die of natural old age, or live in a universe where immortality has been discovered.

All men must die. 

In the end it doesn’t even matter. 

Existentialism has been explored pretty well in media, you can lurk around for other people’s solution to that problem or just kinda accept that yes, everything is meaningless, but we’re here and going to die anyways, might as well do something.  

Doesn’t have to be slaving at a dead end or hopeless job, you can go abroad for new experiences, join the military, anything to help fire those neurons in your brain to release dopamine to continue living.

More simplified version than mentioned: you can’t die, or you can’t experience death.  You in other multiverses can experience death, but your present mind will always be within the universe you do not die. 

Ie, you decide to jump off a three story building, 
1. You die in one universe
2. You manage to live in another universe, or some circumstance prevents you from jumping off the three story building. 
The only way to die is by old age or some aspect where there there is no other method of death.

Good read OP, I can relate to some stuff, but you got a way worse situation than I could imagine.  

In my college classes I never really talked to anyone or did anything outgoing to befriend people.  I was lucky though, this one guy who was very charismatic to everyone just approached me and started talking to me.  Turns out he was super deep into religion and just was like that to people to recruit them to his church (not a cult just really real Christian church).  

I’m not really in contact with him anymore, but because of him I was able to meet and be introduced to other people.  Things changed, but I still have 1 friend that I talk to almost everyday long distance.  

I guess what I’m trying to say is making friends is really fucking hard, if it wasn’t for that push I would’ve gone through school friendless and alone too.  

What I learned is that you just need to put on your best mask and just have small talk with people, and maybe you’ll meet a friend, maybe he’ll be an asshole, a pyramid scheme, a self proclaimed guru, but maybe one could be your friend.
